items.description: A world's declaration for one companion role: who drives a body that holds the role here and what it wears. A companion is admitted only where its role is declared; a destination that declares nothing for its role refuses it at reservation, and it stays with its custodian.

name.description: The role's name, unique within the document.

driver.description: The Name of this world's own addon that drives the role: the same pinned driver a visitor prefers, or one the author substitutes. Exactly one of this and Accept.

accept.description: Whether this world runs a visitor's own preferred driver, resolved by its pin.

kit.description: The Name an arriving companion moves under. Absent: the default peer kit. A companion re-adopted by its own home placement wears that placement's kit instead.

look.description: The look an arriving companion wears. Absent: the default look.

items.title: WorldRole
